notes.title: Intro arrow + hogo bbs addition
notes.content:
* Added a help arrow for new players starting the game, directing them to the ReadMe file on the desktop.

* Added a hogo/bbs knock knock joke generator.

notes.title: Dum-Dum Halloween
notes.content:
There's a new Dum-Dum activity for Halloween! See the in-game book "Hogonet Site List" to start it:
[list]
[*] Bard Gamly, professional ghost enthusiast, needs your help! He has been building a Hogonet site full of ghost-hunting tips and stories. Problem is, his Hogonet site itself is now haunted! Hogo intelligences--or "ghosts" as Bard calls them--have hidden themselves deep within the pages of Bard's site. It's up to you to track them down and flush them out. If you can puzzle your way through clearing the site of ghosts, Bard just might have a little reward for you.
[/list]
A Hogonet address wlil be available in the "Hogonet Site List" book through October. If it's no longer October, the story can be started or continued at any time by visiting the Hogonet site "bard/ghost" directly.

If you're looking for more Halloween haunts, previous Dum-Dum activities and updates provide more spooky selections to suit the season:
[list]
[*] Pumpkin desktop theme - go to Basic Box and type "desktoptheme pumpkin" to set the mood (type "desktoptheme default" to go back to normal).

[*] You're Next font - in the "System Files" directory, launch the "Fonts" program and choose this creepy default text style.

[*] Haunted House of Fortune - visit the Hogonet site "hogo/haunted" for an interactive story. Multiple possible endings may lead to ghostly encounters or great riches.

[*] Piggy Pop Poo and the Half Humans - have you unlocked the "hogo/library" Hogonet site? If so, this eerie tale based on real science may cause you to never look at people the same way again.
[/list]
Thanks, and Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Update notes for September 24, 2021
notes.content: Addressed an issue where the in-game serial number wasn't displaying a usable number.

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
There have been a few small updates after the game left Early Access. They have addressed issues that recently came up, notably:

[list]
[*] - Fixed an issue where Note Sheet didn't auto-save text that was copied from a text book if Note Sheet was closed by another program, such as OS Upgrade or Shut Down.
[*] - Added minor explanatory context to some quest dialogue to make it a bit easier.
[*] - Added a "reply" button to the Mail program to save time when responding to someone.
[/list]
I'll continue making minor updates and fixes as I discover issues. Thank you to everyone who's been contacting me about them!

notes.title: Dum-Dum exiting Early Access!
notes.content:
Dum-Dum is exiting Early Access!

This has been a long road for me. The game was originally released in Steam's Early Access two years ago. Since then I've added a lot of new content: obvious things like stories and puzzles, and less obvious things like quality of life fixes and updates. Developing this game has been a great experience. But there have also been hurdles.

About a year ago I discovered a major problem: the game's graphics were completely corrupt on certain new laptops. It only seemed to be an issue on a small percentage of computers, but that was enough to bring my creative development to a halt. It was very disheartening. I didn't feel comfortable releasing the final game knowing that it wouldn't work on some people's systems.

The good news is that, while it took awhile to address the core problem, it should now be completely fixed! I uploaded a test fix to the beta channel several months ago, and it has run perfectly on all test computers including the two problem laptops. In addition, during the process of fixing the graphics issue, I discovered a related issue where some users weren't being notified of getting Steam achievements while playing the game. That has now been addressed as well.

In addition to the technical fixes, I've also added a bonus feature:

[list]
[*] After completing the main quest, players now have the opportunity to upgrade the operating system to Hogo OS 1985.1 Edition. This is mainly a "creative" update over 1985.0, allowing for desktop customization like designing and/or coloring unique program icons. There may also be one or two small fun discoveries. Search the in-game Hogo/BBS page to start the upgrade path.
[/list]

At this point I think this version can be called complete and officially exit Early Access. But I do hope that I can add new story and puzzle content in the future. Thank you to everyone who has played the game, and especially for all of the kind comments and support! I set out to make the type of game that I would have enjoyed playing myself. I'm glad that it was discovered by other people who have felt similarly. :)

notes.title: Earn "Doorlars" and Go Shopping
notes.content:
There are now two new features that collectively provide a reward system for playing games.

[list]
[*]GAME BANK - A new program that comes pre-installed with Hogo OS 1985 Edition. It is initially broken and can be fixed by working through a series of puzzles. Once fully operational, leave Game Bank open while playing compatible games to earn "Doorlars," the proprietary currency of the Doormall superstore.
[/list]
[list]
[*]DOORMALL - A Hogonet site for 1985's superest superstore. Use Doorlars to purchase digital items including art, music, and toys that can be accessed within the Hogonet browser. Note: you can also buy "physical" items from Doormall, but you probably shouldn't; these items will remain at the Doormall warehouse and are intended to be used in upcoming quests.
[/list]
Plus: the "Emperor's Clothes" text book now includes a link to the new Hogonet LIbrary of Learning site. Use this link to access a small library of very unique books. However, you'll need to apply for a library card first...

notes.title: New Mini-Quests & Programs
notes.content:
There are a number of new updates. Some of these were added between the last update & now, while others were in the beta branch & have now been moved to the main game.

[list]
[*] MINI-QUEST "The Merry Hackers Club" - Join a group of fellow hackers + apply to become an official Hogo Company employee. Start by reading Merry's Book of Riddles (obtained from the Hogo Store by progressing through the main storyline).

[*] PROGRAM "Talky Mail" - a reward for completing the entire Merry Hackers Club quest. This program lets you talk to & hear the voices of mail recipients. This interface will be used in additional upcoming quests.

[*] MINI-QUEST "Mr. Packard's Problem" - Figure out how to help an independent developer submit a new program to the Hogo board for review. Start by checking the Hogo/BBS in-game bulletin board.

[*] PROGRAM "Hogonet Bookmarks" - a reward for completing the Mr. Packard's Problem quest. Use it with Hogonet Reader to save and access Hogonet page links.

[*] GAME UPDATE "Hogowiz Keep" - The game now has 16 puzzle levels with many new building materials.

[*] ACHIEVEMENTS - Two new Hogowiz Keep achievements: one for completing all 16 levels, another for collecting all of the building materials.
[/list]

There are also various small fixes and easter eggs to be discovered. They include new Basic Box "hacking" commands to mess with the Hogo operating system, a new "red screen of death" system to intercept errors (and offer a brief chat with a friendly Hogo Company employee), and additional background images including Spring & Summer.

notes.title: Cheesy Maze
notes.content:
Added a short new game to the in-game bulletin board:
[list]
[*] CHEESY MAZE - A simple game of navigating a 3D maze to locate a piece of cheese. When you are within range of the cheese, a detector shows how close it is but not which direction to go. A pseudo-first person view generated with font characters.
[/list]
To play, launch Hogonet Reader and enter the address Hogo/BBS. Cheesy Maze is located under Games.

notes.title: New Storyline in Development
notes.content:
Most of our focus right now is on developing a new storyline + associated Hogo OS programs. It will be awhile before it's all ready, so updates for the upcoming weeks will be relatively small.
[list]
[*] This week's update adds two new levels in Hogowiz Keep, bringing the total to six.
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer Test
notes.content:
A local multiplayer option is now available in Hogowiz Keep. Trying local multiplayer requires two instances of Dum-Dum running on the same network (only two players can play in multiplayer at the moment). This is the beginning of our multiplayer efforts; eventually, we hope to add more multiplayer options including online.

To try local multiplayer:
[list]
[*] Launch Hogowiz Keep
[*] Hit ESC to enter the menu
[*] Hit either Shift-H to host or Shift-C to join a hosted game
[/list]
Additional updates:
[list]
[*] New "Winter" desktop theme. Launch Basic Box and type "desktoptheme winter" to activate, or "desktoptheme default" to deactivate.
[*] Added two additional Hogowiz Keep puzzle levels with new blocks to collect.
[/list]
All of the Hogowiz Keep levels have been tested & are absolutely solvable! If it seems impossible, try looking for a different route...

notes.title: Hogowiz Keep New Level
notes.content:
Updated Hogowiz Keep, the bonus game that you can install from the Hogo/BBS Hogonet site. There are now three stages to each game level:
[list]
[*] First, find a way to reach your cat familiar.
[*] Next, lead your cat familiar to your cauldron, which will enable building for that level. Picking up new blocks will allow you to "learn" how to build with them.
[*] When the blue portal appears, step inside to unlock the next level.
[/list]
The list of unlocked levels is available from the Hogowiz Keep menu. There are currently two levels to explore & learn new building materials from.

Anything built on the first level should now be saved when quitting Hogowiz Keep. However, any building done on other levels will not currently be saved.

notes.title: Hogo BIOS
notes.content:
Hogo OS 1985 Edition now has a simulated BIOS that provides new features.

When the game is first launched, or if you are upgrading Hogo OS to a different operating system during gameplay, a string of boot-up text appears (e.g. "Starting Hogocore"). Hold down the delete key for one second while this text is on-screen to enter the BIOS.

Hogo BIOS offers several features:
[list]
[*] HINTS - if you are stuck trying to complete the main quest, this option identifies the section that you're currently working on, and provides information on how to get past it!
[*] BOOT - Customize the text that you see while the game is first launching.
[*] RESET - This offers the ability to completely reset the main Dum-Dum story to the very beginning. This option is only available if you have completed the main story.
[/list]
In addition, there have been a few other updates since last week:
[list]
[*] ROCK RUNNER SAVE STATE - If you are working through the levels of Rock Runner on Hogo/BBS, your current level will now be retained even if you close the Hogonet Reader window. However, you will still reset to level 1 if you quit Dum-Dum completely.
[*] ROCK RUNNER CHEAT - If you are attempting to get the Rock Runner achievement, you can now use a cheat to jump straight to the random levels at any time. See the in-game Hogo/BBS bulletin board for more information.
[*] HOGOWORD SHUFFLE - The text book "Win at Video Games" now has tips on how to beat this challenging game.
[/list]
As always, more updates coming next week.

notes.title: Hogowiz Keep Updates
notes.content:
Multiple small updates to Hogowiz Keep have been added over the past week. Hogowiz Keep has also now been moved from beta to the main branch. Changes since last week include:
[list]
[*] A cat companion that follows you around & unlocks new features (currently the ability to build, with more features coming soon).
[*] New updated landscape art and layout.
[*] New streamlined controls for placing and removing blocks.
[*] New menu interface.
[*] Ability to "learn" about new blocks by picking them up, adding them to your list of building materials.
[/list]
We've also been testing multiplayer functionality, which will be made broadly available in an upcoming update. Hogowiz Keep will continue to be expanded over the upcoming weeks.

To try Hogowiz Keep, launch Dum-Dum and go to the "Hogo/BBS" Hogonet page in-game. Look on the message board for how to get started.

notes.title: New Game, Music Programming in BASIC
notes.content:
New additions in this week's update:
[list]
[*] GAME "Rock Runner" - dig tunnels underground to collect gems, while avoiding being crushed by large rocks. Available on the games page of the "Hogo/BBS" Hogonet site.
[*] STEAM ACHIEVEMENT "Rocky Road" - complete the first eight levels of Rock Runner (the first seven are the core levels, while number eight is randomly generated).
[*] BASIC BOX "Note" command - add music notes to BASIC programs. Type "Help Note" in BASIC Box for more information on this new command.
[/list]
Also increased the control accuracy when playing TIPY 5 with a mouse or touchscreen.

notes.title: BBS Games & Halloween Theme
notes.content:
Hogo OS 1985 Edition has a new Halloween "pumpkin" theme! Plus, the Hogo BBS site (hogo/bbs) now has a new games category. It includes a couple of simple old-school games with graphics made entirely from the existing Hogo OS fonts.
[list]
[*] GAME "Pellet Packer" - collect all the pellets while avoiding roaming enemies
[*] GAME "TIPY 5" - grab keys from a scrolling landscape to unlock portals to new regions
[*] DESKTOP THEME  "Pumpkin"
[/list]
To use desktop themes, see the instructions in an updated post on the Hogo BBS message board in-game.

notes.title: Hogo BBS and Desktop Customization
notes.content:
A couple of new updates are on the beta branch:
[list]
[*] Hogo OS now has a virtual in-game bulletin board system (BBS), primarily used as a primitive forum. It is accessible through the Hogonet Reader. There are currently only a few things to explore, but this will be expanded in future updates. See the text book "Hogo OS Pro Tips" by Hogo Sub-worker #64 for the Hogo BBS address.
[*] It is now possible to fully customize the position of icons on your desktop. Visit the new Hogo BBS in-game (see above) for directions on how to do this.
[/list]
To switch to the beta branch: right-click on Dum-Dum in your Steam game list, choose Properties, click on the Betas tab, and select "beta" from the drop-down list.

notes.title: End Game Bonus Content
notes.content:
A couple new additions this week:
[list]
[*]A new program Window+ expands the number of windows Hogo OS 1985 Edition can open at once, from three to eight! It is a reward for completing the main story, at which point it will appear in the Store with enough credit to download it.
[*]The Hogonet site for the "Amazing Hogonet Magician" can be found in the "Hogonet Site List" book.
[/list]

notes.title: New Beta Features
notes.content:
Dum-Dum now has a beta branch. New features will initially be added here, tested for a week or two, then moved to the main branch. We currently have several new additions:
[list]
[*] A new Hogonet site for Smellco, a company founded by a disgruntled Hogo ex-employee. Find its address in the "Hogonet Site List" book.
[*] A new mini-quest related to Smellco. Completing it results in a new achievement "Sweet Smell of Success"
[*] Testing background wallpaper themes with images. Use the Basic Box command "DESKTOPTHEME 1" to see an autumn theme, or "DESKTOPTHEME 0" to revert to the default desktop.
[/list]
To switch to the beta branch: right-click on Dum-Dum in your Steam game list, choose Properties, click on the Betas tab, and select "beta" from the drop-down list.
